description: Rules regarding the recitation of certain words in Surah al-Fatiha where the qurra differ.

maaliki.title: Māliki
maaliki.description: In ayah 3 of al-Fatiha read the word مَالِكِ with the alif (i.e. the long vowel in Māliki)

maliki.title: Maliki
maliki.description: In ayah 3 of al-Fatiha read the word مَلِكِ with out the alif (i.e. no long vowel, Maliki)

sirat-with-seen.title: Sirāṭ
sirat-with-seen.description: The words الصِّرَاطَ / صِرَاطَ wherever they occur are read with a س.

ishmam_of_sad.title: Ishmām of ص
ishmam_of_sad.description: The ص in the words الصِّرَاطَ / صِرَاطَ will be read with ishmām. Ishmām of the letter ص with the letter ز means to mix the two letters together in a way that neither letters are purely pronounced. Rather, a new letter is created with the istiʿlāʾ quality of ص but a dominant ز sound.
ishmam_of_sad.note: Imam Khallad ONLY makes ishmam on the first الصِّرَاطَ in Sūrah al-Fātihah.

ilayhum_ladayhum_alayhum.title: Ilay-hum, Laday-hum, 'Alay-hum
ilayhum_ladayhum_alayhum.description: These words are read with a dhamma on the ه wherever they occur in both waqf and wasl
ilayhum_ladayhum_alayhum.note: Imam Kisāʾī will also recite a dhamma on the ه but only when these words are followed by a sukoon. This is further explained in the rules for mīm al-jam'.
